final: WITH g AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS ga FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), o AS (SELECT AVG(ga) AS oa FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.telescref, g.ga, g.ga - o.oa AS diff FROM g JOIN o ON o.oa IS NOT NULL WHERE g.ga > o.oa), m AS (SELECT AVG(ga) AS ma FROM k) SELECT k.telescref, k.ga, k.diff, k.ga / m.ma AS ratio FROM k JOIN m ON m.ma IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (k.ga / m.ma) IS NULL, k.ga / m.ma DESC LIMIT 10
